outcome: Other ocular findings (disc pallor, cataract, ptosis, amblyopia, keratoconus, telecanthus, lagophthalmos, blepharitis, retinitis pigmentosa, and morning glory syndrome)
cohort: 128 children with developmental delay <16 years of age
finding: Ocular findings were prevalent (85.93%) among children with developmental delay, with refractive error being the most common (68%), followed by strabismus (51.6%) and vision impairment (39.84%).
mod_finding: There was a weak negative correlation between mode of delivery and ocular findings.
